summary: Expanded a US-listed universe for direct and second-order exposure to grid equipment shortages, high-voltage transmission hardware, grid power-quality systems, and renewable/data-center integration. The reference lane is represented by Hubbell as a diversified utility T&D leader. The underfollowed lane surfaces Preformed Line Products, American Superconductor, and Powell Industries as smaller or more niche public companies with plausible exposure to grid buildout, power-quality, utility qualification, and schedule-critical electrical infrastructure. No buy/sell view is implied.
